title: Interpretatio libri Didymi de Spiritu sancto ad Paulinianum
author: Jerome
source: Translated by Claude from tmp417.tmp417.opp-lat1, as held by Open Greek and Latin's Patrologia Latina.

passages.original: Sed non ante annum 389 videtur absoluta, cum aemulorum invidiam declinans, Hierosolymae se recepisset, pariterque esset Bethlemi cum Pauliniano fratre, Paula et Eustochio. Eumdem plus minus annum in- dicat in Catalogo, ubi inter Hebraicorum Nominum librum, et Homilias in Lucam ex Origene, labo- rem hunc memorat.
passages.english: But it does not seem to have been completed before the year 389, when, avoiding the envy of his rivals, he had withdrawn to Jerusalem and was at Bethlehem together with his brother Paulinian, Paula and Eustochium. He indicates more or less the same year in the Catalogue, where he mentions this work between the book of Hebrew Names and the Homilies on Luke from Origen.
passages.notes: The 'Catalogue' is Jerome's De viris illustribus. Scanning hyphenations ('in- dicat', 'labo- rem') have been read as single words.
